plan.title: Refuse RFQ withdrawal without a reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects required for the RFQ event.
Keep counter offers visible on RFQ events as required by the case configuration.
Allow buyer bid actions during the live bidding window as configured.
Enable buyer bid editing required by the case configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers required by the case configuration.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its Settings menu.
Open the RFQ Responses tab as the case specifies.
Open RFQ Settings, choose Withdraw, and confirm without entering a reason to test the required-remark refusal.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Assert that Procol asks for the missing withdrawal reason and does not complete the withdrawal.
